authorization: Dexter explicitly authorized the complete RM1 implementation and, on 2026-07-28, confirmed the P3-B R-24 per-operation requirement mapping and non-leaking readback/conflict projection.

plan.anchor: ### RM1-P3-B｜写端点、R-24 单项授权、receipt 与 FK

r24OperationIdentityAndCapabilityMapping.rule: R-24 has one REQ per POST/DELETE operation. Both REQs map through the authoritative registry to the existing BC-ORG-HEAD-COMPANY-BRAND business capability; BC is not substituted into x-required-capability.

r24ReadbackAndConflictProjection.rule: Readback excludes referencingStoreCount. A remove conflict returns at most 20 actor-visible blocker {id,code,name} entries or the same generic typed conflict, without totals, hasAdditional, canRevoke, hidden-reference indicators, or raw persistence detail.

uiBoundary.rule: P3-B changes generated consumer contract surfaces only. The current multi-select P3-D page is not reinterpreted as approved single-action UI and its behavior remains deferred to accepted RM1-IA-03.

actualChangeSurfaceCorrection.reason: The frozen manifest names the R-24 OpenAPI path, organization owner and edge app, but P3-B's approved receipt-first protocol, generator-derived per-operation requirement mapping, additive composite FK, cross-owner public commands, typed problem conversion and generated consumer artifacts require their existing owning source roots. The correction makes these already-approved dependencies enumerable without adding a Journey or UI behavior.
